items.text:
I cannot recommend this game. There is a good core concept and game underneath, but underdeveloped features and bad design decisons drag it down hard. It is also buggy.

The main issue is that you have to micromanage [i]every[/i] action through a very clunky ui, because the few automation tools you have are incredibly barebones. As an example just locking and unlocking the airlock when you go through it so NPCs dont randomly decide to vent all your ships oxygen into space requires you to manually input the pin code every time.
items.text_zh:
我不能推荐这款游戏。底下有一个不错的核心概念和游戏，但未开发完善的功能和糟糕的设计决策把它狠狠拖垮了。它还有很多bug。

主要问题是你必须通过一个非常笨拙的UI来微观管理[i]每一个[/i]动作，因为你拥有的少数自动化工具极其简陋。举个例子，仅仅是在你穿过气闸时锁定和解锁它，以免NPC随机决定把你飞船里的氧气全部排到太空中，就需要你每次都手动输入密码。

observations.description: 自动化工具功能过于简陋
